scholarship_title: WMG (University of Warwick) Africa Bursary and Excellence Scholarships, September 2027 entry
degree_fields: WMG full-time campus-based MSc programmes (engineering, management, supply chain, etc.)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Automatic GBP 4,000 Africa Bursary; plus merit-based WMG Excellence Scholarships of GBP 5,000, 8,000, 10,000 or 15,000 (tuition only)

application_fee.notes: Not stated on the scholarship page.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: Excellence awards based on academic track record and/or strong professional profile

required_documents.name: Application to a full-time WMG MSc starting September 2027
required_documents.detail: All applicants considered automatically; no separate form stated

preparation_alerts: Self-funded or student-loan funded only for the bursary
Awards are tuition discounts only (no cash, housing or living costs)
Apply early; unsuccessful candidates for Excellence awards are not notified

selection_criteria.pass_rule: Excellence awardees told with or shortly after the offer

source_urls.title: WMG, University of Warwick: scholarships for African students (September 2027 entry)
source_urls.used_for: Bursary and Excellence amounts, eligibility, conditions

verification_status.verification_notes: Official WMG page for September 2027 entry. No separate deadline stated; WMG MSc applications reportedly close 31 Aug 2027 (search results). Partial tuition awards only. The earlier IDP figure of GBP 3,500 bursary is outdated.
